newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn auctions Series 121 Bobl, sets new Series 122.
newsitem.headline: Bonn auctions Series 121 Bobl, sets new Series 122.

text.p: The German government on Monday set an auction to top up its Series 121 4.75 percent Bundesobligationen or Bobl bonds and launched a new Series 122 Bobl which will be issued on tap to non-bank investors, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said.

Bids from banks for the top-up of the Series 121 Bobl are due by 1000 GMT on Tuesday, the Bundesbank said. The bond matures on November 20, 2001, the settlement date is on Thursday and the portion will be listed on Friday.

The new Series 122 has a 4.50 percent coupon and goes on sale to non-bank investors at an initial issue price of 100.60, for a yield of 4.36 percent, the Bundesbank said. It matures on February 22, 2002.
